={{ { branch_id: $("Extract branch_id").first().json.branch_id, member_id: ($("Upsert Member").first().json[0]?.id || $("Upsert Member").first().json.id), channel: "whatsapp" } }}

={{ { conversation_id: $('Resolve conversation_id').first().json.conversation_id, sender: 'assistant', message: ($json.reply || $json.message || 'Thank you for reaching out to RCCG Everflourishing Mega Sanctuary!') } }}

[ { type: 'header', parameters: [ { type: 'image', image: { link: $json.flyer_url } } ] }, { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: $json.tpl_title }, { type: 'text', text: $json.tpl_member_name }, { type: 'text', text: $json.tpl_message_body } ] } ] : [ { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: $json.tpl_title }, { type: 'text', text: $json.tpl_member_name }, { type: 'text', text: $json.tpl_message_body } ] } ] } } }}
